description: This file defines the interface for a buffer management module used within the rbus communication system. It includes function declarations for creating, destroying, reading from, and writing to an rbusBuffer, as well as functions for encoding and decoding rbusValues and rbusFilters. The file sets up the structure and function prototypes for handling binary data buffers used in message serialization and deserialization within the rbus framework.

methods.description: Releases resources associated with the rbusBuffer.
